text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl's scheduled training session has started, but she's nowhere to be seen. I go searching for her…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Escargots à la Bourguignonne. Galette Bretonne.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Once I start winning races around the world, I'll have to give interviews in different countries, right?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: So I'm studying different languages to prepare myself! I'm working on my French right now. After that, I'll study—
choice_data_list: You'll need to train if you want to win.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Huh? Well, obviously! Training is the first step toward conquering the wor—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh my gosh! Did I completely forget about today's training session?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry, Trainer! This is so embarrassing! I won't let this happen ever again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl appears genuinely remorseful, so I decide to overlook today's incident.
